Barry Moore

Republican candidate for United States Senator, Alabama · Open seat

U.S. Representative for Alabama's 1st Congressional District; businessman (co-owner of Barry Moore Industries)

Barry Moore is a Republican U.S. Representative from Enterprise, Alabama. He has served in Congress since 2021, representing the 2nd District through 2025 and the 1st District since then, and he served in the Alabama House from 2010 to 2018. He announced his run for the open U.S. Senate seat held by Tommy Tuberville in August 2025, was endorsed by President Donald Trump in January 2026, and won the Republican nomination in the June 16, 2026 primary runoff.

Where Moore stands

Border security and immigration
Says there should be zero tolerance for illegal immigration and that Congress must act to secure the border.
Taxes
Cites his record of cutting taxes on tips, overtime and Social Security as a campaign priority.
Gun rights
Pledges to defend Second Amendment rights. He has been endorsed by the NRA and Gun Owners of America.
Gender identity and education
Says he has worked to prevent what he calls the indoctrination of children with a 'Democrat trans agenda.'
Public safety
Campaigned on backing law enforcement.
Government ethics and lobbying
Introduced the BLAST Act, which would ban members of Congress from lobbying, saying the 'revolving door in Washington needs to be closed.'

Background

  • U.S. Representative, Alabama's 1st District, 2025–present
  • U.S. Representative, Alabama's 2nd District, 2021–2025
  • Alabama House of Representatives, District 91, 2010–2018
  • Member of the House Freedom Caucus; serves on the House Agriculture and Judiciary committees
  • Served in the U.S. Army National Guard
  • Co-owner and co-operator of Barry Moore Industries
  • Education: A.S., Enterprise State Community College; attended Troy University; B.S. in agricultural science, Auburn University
  • Won the 2026 Republican U.S. Senate nomination in the June 16, 2026 primary runoff against Jared Hudson
